MSI MAG 256F Gaming Monitor Specifications

​The MSI MAG 256F is a fast-paced gaming monitor designed for competitive clarity. It features a "Rapid IPS" panel, which significantly reduces motion blur while maintaining high color fidelity, making it a top contender for FPS and eSports enthusiasts.

​Display Specifications

  • ​Panel Size: 24.5-inch
  • ​Panel Type: Rapid IPS
  • ​Resolution: 1920 x 1080 (Full HD)
  • ​Refresh Rate: 180Hz
  • ​Response Time: 1ms (GtG)
  • ​Brightness: 250 nits (Typical)
  • ​Contrast Ratio: 1000:1 (Static)
  • ​Color Gamut:   127% sRGB ...91% DCI-P3
  • ​Viewing Angles: 178° Horizontal / 178° Vertical
  • ​Surface Treatment: Anti-glare

​Gaming & Visual Features

  • ​Adaptive-Sync: Synchronizes the display refresh rate with your GPU to eliminate screen tearing.
  • ​Wide Color Gamut: Fine-tuned to provide more realistic and refined colors for improved immersion.
  • ​AI Vision: New technology that reveals details in dark areas while optimizing overall brightness and saturation.
  • ​Anti-Flicker & Less Blue Light: TUV Rheinland certified to reduce eye strain and fatigue during extended play.
  • ​Console Mode: Optimized to work seamlessly with modern consoles at high refresh rates.

​Connectivity

  • ​DisplayPort: 1 x DisplayPort 1.2a (Supports 180Hz)
  • ​HDMI: 2 x HDMI 2.0b (Supports 180Hz)
  • ​Audio: 1 x Headphone Out

​Physical Design

  • ​Tilt Adjustment: -5° ~ 20°
  • ​VESA Mounting: 75 x 75 mm
  • ​Bezel: Frameless design for a multi-monitor setup and modern look.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Rapid IPS Technology: Offers a 1ms GtG response time, which is significantly faster than standard IPS panels, virtually eliminating ghosting.
  • ​180Hz High Refresh Rate: Provides extremely fluid motion, giving you a competitive edge in fast-action games.
  • ​Exceptional Color Volume: With 127% sRGB coverage, the colors are more vibrant and "pop" more than typical budget gaming monitors.
  • ​Sleek 24.5" Form Factor: The preferred size for many professional eSports players as it stays within the human eye's natural field of focus.
